open.speaker: Odd
open.text: Mind the third table. It has opinions about elbows.

errand.speaker: Odd
errand.text: Running for Kesk, are you? He's been at that ledger so long the ink's gone to sea.

paid.speaker: Odd
paid.text: Kesk paid out? Sit down. I want to hear how you managed it, and I want to hear it slowly.
